description: This file defines the Api class within the Opencart admin model for user API management, including methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving API records and related IP and history data.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Class providing CRUD operations and data retrieval for API records, IP addresses, and histories within the Opencart admin user model.

methods.name: addApi
methods.description: Creates a new API record in the database with provided data, including optional IP addresses.

methods.name: editApi
methods.description: Updates an existing API record identified by api_id with new data, replacing associated IP addresses.

methods.name: deleteApi
methods.description: Deletes an API record and its associated IP addresses from the database.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Retrieves a specific API record by its api_id.

methods.name: getApis
methods.description: Retrieves a list of API records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalApis
methods.description: Returns the total count of API records.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP address associated with a specific API record.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Deletes all IP addresses associated with a specific API record.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP addresses associated with a specific API record.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves API history records with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history records for a specific API.
